rationale: The breakout above the $10.00 psychological level and $9.99 prior day high has failed to attract follow-through, with 1-minute volume drying up to under 2,000 shares per bar and price slipping back below both $9.99 and the 5-minute 9-EMA ($9.96). Closing the position removes exposure to a stalled midday breakout before it tests the $9.88 stop, while avoiding a short flip against the broader intraday uptrend and wide 20.1 bps spread.
